item.title: BENJI’S BEST
item.description: BENJAMIN NYGREN hit a screen gem to light up a grey December afternoon in Livingston as Celtic claimed three crucial points in a 4-2 success over the hosts. The Swede, a bargain £1.7million summer arrival, hoisted his goal tally to 10 with a double salvo against David Martindale’s Premiership basement club. The Hoops conceded twice [...]

item.title: WATCH AGAIN: TRES FOUR-MIDABLE, WILF
item.description: A LOT has happened at Celtic since the champions last played Tuesday night’s opponents Motherwell. item.title: Nygren MVP
item.description: Benjamin Nygren was an unused substitute two weeks ago as Celtic fell to St Mirren at Hampden. He opened Celtic’s scoring account in the two subsequent games, against Aberdeen then yesterday at Livingston. That moves him onto 8 league goals for the season, second in the Premiership scorer’s table behind Lawrence Shankland. No one in [...]

item.title: ‘KEEP FIGHTING,’ McCOWAN’S CASE FOR THE DEFENCE
item.description: LUKE McCOWAN admits only sheer hard work and battling qualities will allow Celtic a case for the defence. item.title: Possession Motherwell and high press Celtic
item.description: We saw enough about Motherwell at Celtic Park in October to know how difficult an opponent they will be tomorrow night. The Lanarkshire side took a second half lead and were undone when their keeper passed to Benjamin Nygren, who levelled, before Daizen Maeda scored a 92nd minute winner. item.title: CHALLENGING TIMES WITH NANCY
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY admits it’s all about challenges as he prepares his Celtic players for tomorrow night’s crucial Premiership encounter against Motherwell at Fir Park. item.title: MOTHERWELL v CELTIC: 5-MINUTE QUIZ
item.description: WILFRIED NANCY is aiming to complete a hat-trick of Premiership victories against Motherwell at Fir Park this evening.
